'''Pela''' is a girl NPC who appears at Jamie's Farm in [[Whisperwind Haven]]. She's part of the Jamie Family.

''(To Be Added)
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Pela:''' Hello, welcome to Jamie's Farm. If you're looking for Lucio, he should be herding near Egla Town.
:{{DIcon}} Could you tell me about your family?
::'''Pela:''' As you can see, the Jamie family is just an ordinary herding family living outside Egla Town. They lack noble status, background with The Order, or any accumulated wealth.
::'''Pela:''' These are Lucio, Julia, and Pela. Their primary business partners are the merchants and the bakery in Egla Town.
::{{DIcon}} Your way of speaking is quite particular.
::'''Pela:''' Pela exhibits certain cognitive impairments, according to Acolyte Wicktorio's analysis.
::'''Pela:''' Julia and Lucio suffered an incident twenty years ago that left a lasting impact on their minds.
:: Their offspring, Pela, possesses excellent logical abilities but lacks emotional understanding and self-awareness.
:{{DIcon}} What's your birthday wish?
::'''Pela:''' Every year on that day, Lucio and Julia would spend a fortune to prepare storybooks for Pela.
::'''Pela:''' The works they are preparing are poised for commercial success. Thus, Pela surmises that Julia and Lucio expect her to write scripts that will generate profit.
::'''Pela:''' Unfortunately, without empathy, Pela can't become a great author.
:{{DIcon}} Thank you. See you then.
::'''Pela:''' Goodbye.
{{Dialogue End}}
